name: efflux
description: Efflux — a deployable Cloudflare agent runtime built on Effect v4 and native Workers bindings. No framework required.

scripts.typecheck: bun run cf-typegen && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/tui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/container/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run --filter @efflux/web build && bun run --filter @efflux/api typecheck
scripts.dev:local: bun scripts/dev-preflight.ts && bun scripts/upload-skills.ts --local && wrangler dev
